Every `upnext feed` command and its help, as `--help` prints it. Each also accepts the [global flags](/commands#global-flags).

## `upnext feed`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Print what's live, new and saved

USAGE
  upnext feed [flags]

FLAGS
  --json    Print the feed as JSON

INHERITED FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the daemon socket (default: $UPNEXT_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/upnext/upnext.sock)
```
